title: nodaps: wire asteroid_files into nodaps_osc_body_j2000's SwephProvider
description: nodaps_osc_body_j2000's Swiss branch constructs SwephProvider with asteroid_files: &[] (context.rs ~line 1399). Body::Asteroid passes nod_aps's rejection guard (raw > AST_OFFSET), so nod_aps(eph, t, Body::asteroid(433), flags, OSCU) reaches nodaps_osc_body_j2000 which calls provider.positions(Body::Asteroid(433), ...) — this hits the new Body::Asteroid branch in SwephProvider::positions and returns EphemerisNotAvailable because the file list is empty. Pre-existing (before swisseph-rs/158 it hit a different error from the planet_files lookup miss), but now that the routing is explicit, the fix is to pass &self.asteroid_files. Same applies to planet_moon_files if planet moons ever pass the nod_aps guard (currently rejected by the NPLANETS..AST_OFFSET range check, so not reachable). Found by Codex adversarial review of swisseph-rs/158.
root_cause: Both nodaps SwephProvider construction sites (nodaps_observer and nodaps_osc_body_j2000) hardcoded asteroid_files: &[] and planet_moon_files: &[], so any Body::Asteroid(n) reaching the Swiss backend's provider.positions() hit the empty file list and returned EphemerisNotAvailable.
